name: Ear Shift
description: On headphones any sound beats between the ears. Only a band is shifted, where the frequency shifter's stereo mode moves it all, and Ears can bring the beat into the air.

params.name: Beat
params.description: How many times a second the beat between the ears comes round. The band is moved up by half of it in the left ear and down by half in the right.

params.name: Ears
params.description: At full the band goes up in the left ear and down in the right. Speakers, a mono fold or a reverb fed from both sides make that a pulse in the air, as zero does outright.

params.name: Low
params.description: Bottom of the shifted band. Sound well below it passes unshifted. A note within an octave of this edge is part shifted and wavers at half the rate of Beat.

params.name: High
params.description: Top of the shifted band. Sound well above it passes unshifted. A note within an octave of this edge wavers at half the rate of Beat. It stays half an octave over Low.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit, cpp/kit/beat.h and cpp/kit/band.h. A band of the input is shifted up in the left ear and down in the right through a phase difference network; no unit or plug-in is modelled.
